name: DOGFOOD 2026
description: Build the platform that will judge you. One product, four tiers, a T1 gate, weighted criteria on a 0 to 5 scale, bonuses that only break ties.

criteria.label: T1 cleared (gate)
criteria.description: Clear T1 or you are not judged: auth, roles, events, teams, submissions with drafts, deadline enforcement, public gallery.

anchors.0: T1 not cleared: the project is not scored.

criteria.label: Tier Completion & Correctness
criteria.description: How far up the ladder, verified by the acceptance report rather than the README. Correctness beats breadth. Honest gap reporting is rewarded; inflated claims are penalised.

anchors.1: T1 only, with failures or claims the report does not verify.
anchors.3: T2 verified cleanly, or higher tiers with notable gaps honestly reported.
anchors.5: Every claimed tier verified and correct; gaps reported in the team's own words.

criteria.label: Judging Integrity
criteria.description: Role isolation enforced in the backend, a documented and defensible normalization method, an audit trail an organizer can read, abuse considered up front.

anchors.1: Checks live in the UI or scores are simply averaged.
anchors.3: Backend isolation and a documented normalization; limited audit.
anchors.5: Isolation proven, normalization defended with evidence, readable audit trail, abuse modelled.

criteria.label: Adoptability & Operability
criteria.description: Could this run in production on Monday: one command, seeded with real data, docs a stranger can follow, a migration path in and out, a clean license.

anchors.1: Hard to start or depends on hosted services.
anchors.3: One command works; documentation has gaps.
anchors.5: Runs offline in one command, clear docs, data can move in and out.

criteria.label: Code Quality & Innovation
criteria.description: Idiomatic by the standard of a senior reviewer in that stack, a schema worth defending, design decisions worth stealing.

anchors.1: Hard to follow; schema not defended.
anchors.5: A schema a database person would defend and at least one decision worth stealing.

prizes.name: Grand Prize: the portal that gets forked and run
